Workify is a free online service to work with PDF files: merge, split, compress, convert, rotate, unlock and watermark PDFs with just a few clicks.
Workify is a free, web-based suite of PDF tools: merge, split, compress, convert, edit, sign, redact and more, with reusable workflows and installable desktop and mobile apps, in 11 languages.
Workify is built with Next.js and runs on your own server, so organisations can keep documents in-house.
